title: Act 1 - Segment 6: Saffron City to Silph Co. (Marsh Badge)
synopsis: Infiltrate the 11-floor Silph Co. corporate headquarters in Saffron City to liberate the gift Lapras, claim the Master Ball, and defeat Giovanni. Test your mettle in the Fighting Dojo for Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan, then challenge Gym Leader Sabrina's lethal Psychic roster in a 4v4 duel under the Level 45 cap.
